wahl_portal_disclosure_trigger: Where do these numbers come from?
wahl_portal_disclosure_text: Berlin and Bezirk values are official totals from the election offices. Kiez values are an area-based aggregate derived from the polling districts, not an official original value. Postal votes are officially included in the Bezirk and Berlin totals; at Kiez level, a group's postal votes are distributed proportionally by eligible voters across its polling districts: an estimate, not an official breakdown.

wahl_portal_disclaimer_footnote: Maps and comparisons on this page are descriptive, not a ranking of Kieze or Bezirke. Vote shares are not an indicator of future elections.
wahl_portal_disclaimer_stimmenanteile: Data describe vote shares, not an assessment. At Kiez level, postal votes are an estimate distributed proportionally by eligible voters, not an official figure. Official values exist at polling district, Bezirk, and Berlin level.

wahl_portal_page_title: Berlin Elections - Election results on the map - navigator.berlin
wahl_portal_page_description: Bundestag, Berlin House of Representatives (Abgeordnetenhaus), and District Assembly (BVV) elections in Berlin since 2011: map, change, trends, and election-year transitions by Kiez and Bezirk.
wahl_portal_dataset_description: Bundestag, Berlin House of Representatives (Abgeordnetenhaus), and District Assembly (BVV) election results by polling district, Kiez, Bezirk, and Berlin total.
wahl_portal_chapter_karte_subtext: In the winner tab, the coloring shows the leading party per area; in the party tabs, the share of the selected party. Year and level apply only to this chapter.
wahl_portal_chapter_wechsel_subtext: The map counts how often an area changed its leading party within the selected election series. The list below names the changes with year, old and new party.
wahl_portal_chapter_trends_subtext: The map shows the direction and strength of each party's vote-share trend, or the volatility of all parties combined. The toggle and party chips only change the coloring, not the data fetched.
wahl_portal_chapter_uebergaenge_subtext: Each column stands for an election year; each band groups areas with the same party sequence between two elections, even without a change of leading party. Hover or focus shows the exact numbers.
wahl_portal_chapter_extreme_subtext: The maps show, per party, the area with the highest and the lowest vote share in the selected year.
wahl_portal_chapter_methodik_subtext: This lists the sources and licenses of all election datasets, with links to the full methodology page and the license overview.
